2610.08675.title: Same-Number Citation Swaps: Stress-Testing Jev as a Financial Evidence Judge
2610.08675.paper_summary: Financial reports repeat values across periods, metrics and accounting lines, allowing an LLM-generated calculation to be numerically correct while citing the wrong financial role. We evaluate what probabilistic evidence verification adds beyond number matching using Jev as a source-support verifier for GPT-4.1-mini calculation traces. A signed-number-at-pointer baseline explains most recovery over exact quotation checks. To isolate the remaining role-recognition problem, we hold operands and arithmetic fixed, move citations between same-number cells, and retain controls that express equivalent facts. These contrasts reveal both wrong-role citations that pass and valid alternative citations that are withheld. Explicit column labels improve selected wrong-role decisions while also lowering support for some equivalent evidence. A constructed follow-up on 36 new source pages, labeled by a non-author reviewer, extends this evaluation and exposes the same tradeoff between detecting role errors and retaining valid citations. The contribution is a controlled evaluation that identifies what a probabilistic financial verifier distinguishes when numerical matching is held fixed. For LLM-based financial assistants, it makes numerical correctness, cited-role support and acceptance outcomes separately assessable.
2610.08675.paper_summary_zh: 財務報告在各個期間、指標和會計項目中重複數值，這使得LLM生成的計算在數值上是正確的，但引用了錯誤的財務角色。我們評估概率證據驗證在數字匹配之外所增加的價值，使用Jev作為GPT-4.1-mini計算痕跡的來源支持驗證器。一個帶符號的數字基準解釋了大部分在精確引用檢查中的恢復。為了隔離剩餘的角色識別問題，我們保持操作數和算術不變，將引用移動到相同數字的單元格之間，並保留表達等效事實的控制變量。這些對比揭示了既有通過的錯誤角色引用，也有被保留的有效替代引用。明確的列標籤改善了所選擇的錯誤角色決策，同時也降低了一些等效證據的支持。對36個新來源頁面進行的後續構建，由非作者審核者標記，擴展了這一評估，並揭示了檢測角色錯誤與保留有效引用之間的同樣權衡。這一貢獻是一個受控評估，確定了當數字匹配保持固定時，概率財務驗證器所區分的內容。對於基於LLM的財務助手，它使數值正確性、引用角色支持和接受結果可以單獨評估。
